name: @layera-labs/ui
description: React component library for the Orbit v1 editor (Tailwind + Radix)
author: Layera Labs
//bin: An `orbit-ui` bin pointed at ./cli/index.js, a shadcn-style `add <component>` copier. It was removed rather than fixed because it had never run even once as packaged, and was broken twice over: (1) it was CommonJS `require` in a file named .js inside a "type": "module" package, so EVERY invocation — including `help` — died with ReferenceError before parsing an argument; (2) `add` copies from ../src/components/<name>.tsx, and `files` ships only `dist`, so a published install had no source to copy from. Reviving it would mean shipping src/ purely to feed a copier that duplicates what `import { OrbitButton } from '@layera-labs/ui'` already does.
//publishConfig: REGISTRY AND ACCESS ARE NOT DECIDED YET, so publishConfig is deliberately absent rather than guessed. Public npm needs {"access":"public"} (a scoped package defaults to restricted and the publish fails without it). GitHub Packages needs {"registry":"https://npm.pkg.github.com"}; the @layera-labs scope already matches the owning GitHub org, so nothing further has to be renamed. Add exactly one of those here before the first publish.
